description: Five agents installed by their vendors' own curl installers, the route no package manager records.
why: Each installer's own script names where it writes, and each of those places is already enumerated: a file directly under ~/.local/bin, or a top-level ~/.<dir>/. So these agents were invisible for want of a catalog value, not a query. Nothing else on this host can name any of the five -- no npm, no package, no editor -- so removing a value turns its must_find red. claude-code and codex-cli are forbidden because their own routes are ~/.local/bin and top-level home directories too, and five new neighbours there must not be read as either.
known_gaps: Only the installers' Linux branches run here. On macOS opencode, Cursor CLI, goose and Kiro CLI are proved through Homebrew in 21-cli-agents-homebrew; Grok Build's macOS install is unexercised, though ~/.grok is a posix route.

Nothing is run after installing, so state that appears on first use -- ~/.config/goose, ~/.local/share/opencode -- is unexamined. Neither is a top-level directory, so the enumeration would not reach it anyway.
